snippet.title: I Am Bird - Gameplay Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
I Am Bird, available now on Meta Store: 
https://www.meta.com/experiences/i-am-bird/25148042068216938/

We are glad to announce that I Am Bird is now available on December 3, 2025!

I Am Bird is a game where you play as a super-powered bird flying around a big open city, taking on quests and helping people. You can explore rooftops, streets, and wide skies while using different gadgets and abilities.

Complete side activities, rescue citizens, fight enemies, and join aerial races. Fly, dash, dive, and perform tricks as you experience the life of a hero bird in a huge urban world.
